_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for all company facts. Values below are transcribed from the Dubai Commercial License No. 1646635 (issued 20/08/2026). Anything published here must match the trade licence and the D-U-N-S record exactly — with the one exception recorded in _needsReview. After editing, run tools/address.py (if the address changed), then build-faq.py, build-lark.py, seo-inject.py and analytics.py, in that order.
_needsReview: 2026-10-25 ADDRESS AHEAD OF THE REGISTERS. The published address is now 3707, Churchill Tower 1, Business Bay, Dubai, which is where the office is. Trade licence 1646635 still prints the Dubai Industrial City address (Office 08, Building R.SH.038, Saih Shuaib 2), and D-U-N-S 851077092 still carries it too. Amend the licence with the Department of Economy and Tourism and update the D&B record, then delete this entry — until then the site and the registers disagree, and a verifier cross-checking /about/ against the licence will find it. tools/address.py holds both addresses and can move the site either way.
_done: 2026-08-20 hello@, support@ and partners@ mailboxes live on Lark Mail (MX -> larksuite.com)
2026-08-20 DNS live: apex A/AAAA -> GitHub Pages, www CNAME -> zysncb.github.io, MX untouched; site serving at https://oceanastra.net with HTTPS

2026-09-01 D-U-N-S 851077092 recorded (applied to D&B 2026-08-20). Needed for Apple Developer Program enrolment; also printed in the company information table on /about/ in all three languages, and emitted as Organization.duns in the structured data.
_basePathNote: Leave empty for a custom domain (the intended setup). Set to "/OceanAstra-Website" only if the site is served from a GitHub project-pages subpath.
_legalNameNote: The licence prints the name in capitals (OCEANASTRA TECHNOLOGIES L.L.C). Rendered here in title case, which is word-for-word identical and reads correctly in running text.
_emailNote: Three published addresses, all live on Lark Mail. `general` carries enquiries, sales and all legal/privacy correspondence; `support` carries service support for clients and application users, and is the App Store support contact; `partners` carries partnership and vendor-integration enquiries.
_mapNote: Coordinates are the Churchill Tower 1 place marker on Google Maps (https://maps.app.goo.gl/TS4c5Th98nBC1Zd19). mapUrl is written out in full rather than as the short link so the destination is readable in the page source and does not depend on a redirect service.
